text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Power as a percentage of the generator's own capacity, out of fold. Weeks are chosen from measured power alone, never from a weather product, so the choice cannot favour one; see "Data and methods". Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026.'
